name: Hakushoku Syrup ~Boku to Aitsu to Minna no Karada~
original_name: 白色シロップ ～ぼくとあいつとみんなのからだ～
source:
Ryohei has fallen in love with Sarana, who is already Shintaro's girlfriend. Shintaro finds out about Ryohei's confession to Sarana, and lures him to the room where the two of them always play...
